about.description: PAXG is a commodity perpetual listed on MEXC, tracking Pax Gold, margined and cash-settled in USDC. Traders get synthetic price exposure only — no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Funding settles every 4h. Up to 100× leverage. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
